race.description: Procon Developments Northam Cup – Sun 25 Oct Mdn
race.comment: CELESTIAL BOOM (8) missed narrowly on resumption over 1300m here when settling midfield and finishing 0.7L off the winner. Out to the mile now is a big tick and she draws the inside again for Pike. Can settle in a similar position and go one better out in distance. BEND IT LIKE BECKS (1) was trending the right way before tackling the Aquanita Stakes as a maiden where he was outclassed. Back to Maiden company now is a good move, as is coming back to the mile. Chris Parnham reunites and he can play a leading role. SUPAROO (2) hasn't been far away in recent efforts, including a narrow defeat at Belmont two starts back. He's racing well without winning and can put it all together here without surprising. BANGALONG (7) is better than he showed last time out and can't be left out of calculations. FIELD MISTRESS (6) can go one better now.
